title: Vaccine hesitancy and susceptibility to SARS-CoV-2 misinformation in Japanese youth: The contribution of personality traits and national identity
apa: Rivers, D. J., Unser-Schutz, G., & Rudolph, N. (2024). Vaccine hesitancy and susceptibility to SARS-CoV-2 misinformation in Japanese youth: The contribution of personality traits and national identity. International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health, 21(1), Article 42.
summary: Examines how personality traits and national identity contribute to vaccine hesitancy and susceptibility to SARS-CoV-2 misinformation among Japanese youth.

title: The perceived value of remote access online learning: An instrument construction and validation case study
apa: Rivers, D. J. (2023). The perceived value of remote access online learning: An instrument construction and validation case study. Education Sciences, 13(12), Article 1176.
summary: Develops and validates a survey instrument for modelling how students evaluate remote access online learning in relation to self-regulation, institutional support, and perceived educational value.

title: Multimodal gestalts and post-pandemic utopianism: Drum and bass on the bike
apa: Rivers, D. J. (2022). Multimodal gestalts and post-pandemic utopianism: Drum and bass on the bike. Frontiers in Communication, 7, Article 817332.
summary: Analyses cycling-based music performance as a multimodal communicative event shaped by movement, public space, livestreaming, and post-pandemic social imagination.

title: Stress mediates the relationship between personality and the affordance of socially distanced online education
apa: Rivers, D. J. (2022). Stress mediates the relationship between personality and the affordance of socially distanced online education. Human Behavior and Emerging Technologies, 2022, Article 9719729.
summary: Shows how stress mediates the relationship between personality and students’ perceived affordances of socially distanced online education.

title: The Situation Specific Arousal Analyzer (SSAA): Innovation in the physiological assessment of foreign language education anxiety
apa: Rivers, D. J. (2022). The Situation Specific Arousal Analyzer (SSAA): Innovation in the physiological assessment of foreign language education anxiety. Frontiers in Education, 7, Article 802639.
summary: Introduces the SSAA as a method for assessing physiological arousal in foreign language education anxiety research.
